help_portal_text: ABpE Portal - Automated consultant profile acquisition system. Manages CVs, consultants, matching and workflows.
help_nav1: Sidebar: icons become visible on hover
help_nav3: All sections can be expanded/collapsed with a click
help_nav4: Search bar: find consultants, CVs and records across the portal
help_lang_header: Language: buttons top right (DE/EN/ES/IT/FR) or in Settings
help_lang_persist: Your selected language is saved and restored on next login
help_theme_toggle: Light/dark mode: sun/moon button top right or in Settings
help_mod_overview: Each module may have its own help — Help button in the module view
help_mod_email: Email Studio: detailed tutorial with simulations (overview, modules, variables, translation)
help_mod_more: More modules (Doc Studio, Matching, CRM) will be added step by step
